scope: Revised fourth-family long/multiparagraph bodies. Existing short centered policy and other sets remain unchanged.
reservation: Reserved before new body-image inspection for this study. Full-corpus captures/scores and some historic stats crops already exist; this is fresh body-image review, not an untouched dataset.
constraints: Original source wording must be checked before fitting; source corrections remain distinct from renderer deltas.
Frozen family registration remains identity. No per-card transform or geometry.
Render control must reproduce full baseline PNG bytes before candidate metrics.
Freeze shared candidate before inspecting reserved scans. Inspect wrapping and component positions in addition to whole-body scores.
developmentNotes: Centered Animate Wall and smaller-type Clone are visible stress cases; retain their outcomes even if a shared left-block candidate fails them.

Channel target transcription corrected from may be played to are played after viewing the original-resolution scan; source input was already correct. Recompute line metrics offline from stored layouts.
Initial grid preferred the smallest y offset (-4). Extend upward and test 1px width increments because 344 wraps Prodigal/Dwarven correctly while 348 preserves Llanowar. Shared coordinates only.

Refinement resolves nine line patterns, but upward centering puts Clone/Channel above the panel. Clamp the first ink to the existing body rectangle plus 4px; check horizontal placement at the chosen vertical center. This constraint depends on layout and frame geometry, never a scan-specific offset.
